takeaways: Prop plays went 23-35 (-15.46 units) in week 5.
Every-game spread picks went 8-6-1. Most are tiny gaps, so about half is expected.
Best prop type this season: Anytime TD, Under (76-25, +44.08 units). These are long-shot odds, so a few hits swing the total. Likely luck at this sample.
Weakest: Receptions, Under (74-81, -15.55 units). Worth avoiding until it turns.
Closing lines: 7 picks beat the close, 4 were worse, 4 didn't move.
